//: A loader fixture, not a product: one `watch` job granted Spaces, Discover, Content and Log. Each run reads its space's brief, emits a signal on every member through Content, and hands back the candidates its watch settings list through Discover; a watch whose settings say `reachForFacts` reaches for Facts, which it was never granted. apps/worker's discover test runs it through the loader.
name: @spaces/plugin-discover
